The accessibility permission is required to enable the gesture - double tap to lock . Any data acquired by Mafla via this service will not leave your device.
Please set Mafla as default first
Note: Tap on \'Mafla\' at the top of this Settings page to find your hidden apps.

Mafla uses the Accessibility Service API for one feature only: Double tap to lock. It lets Mafla lock your screen when you double tap on the home screen. 

The service only sees taps inside Mafla, and only uses them to lock your screen. It does not look at other apps or anything you type. 

No data is collected, stored or shared. Nothing leaves your device. 

Tap Accept, then turn on Mafla in your device's Accessibility settings.
